en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a formal military ceremony in front of neoclassical buildings. Long rows of uniformed soldiers wearing helmets stand in formation in a courtyard. Civilians and officers observe near the entrance gate. The architecture has arched windows and a central stairway leading into a prominent building. Greek text is printed beneath the image, and there is a vertical caption along the left side listing an edition and photographer.
